sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Cauldron is a crafting station used to prepare food. It requires a fire source underneath to operate, such as a Campfire or Hearth.

sections.heading: Building
sections.text:
Cauldrons can be placed using the Hammer, found under the Crafting tab. A fire does not need to be present to place a Cauldron, only to use/craft with it.
The Cauldron recipe is unlocked only when the player picks up Tin for the first time after smelting it and has a Forge built.

sections.heading: Upgrades
sections.text: Upgrading a Cauldron enables additional crafting recipes. A Cauldron can be upgraded up to level 6 by building the following structures near it:
